units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 17) medical insurance in accordance with the federal law on medical insurance for state servants of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 18) state protection of their life and health, the life and health of their family members, and their property;
units.label: Point 18 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 19) state pension provision in accordance with federal law.
units.label: Point 19 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 2. The duty to ensure a civil servant’s basic rights rests with the employer’s representative.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 3. A civil servant may, after giving prior written notice to the employer’s representative, perform other paid work if this does not give rise to a conflict of interest.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.label: Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 1. A civil servant is obliged to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 1) comply with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, the Charter of the City of Moscow, and laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, and ensure their implementation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 2) perform official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 3) carry out instructions issued by the relevant managers within their powers;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 4) respect the rights and lawful interests of citizens and organizations when performing official duties;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 5) observe the state body's service rules;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 6) maintain the professional level necessary for proper performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 7) not disclose information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal law, or information learned in connection with the performance of official duties, including information concerning citizens' private lives or health or affecting their honour and dignity;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 8) safeguard state property, including property provided for the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 9) submit, in the prescribed manner, information about themselves and their family members as provided for by federal law; 10) notify the employer’s representative in writing of the termination of Russian Federation citizenship, acquisition of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state, or receipt of a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen’s right of permanent residence in a foreign state, on the day the civil servant learns of this, but no later than five working days from the termination of Russian Federation citizenship, acquisition of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state, or receipt of a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen’s right of permanent residence in a foreign state;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 11) observe restrictions, fulfil obligations and requirements for official conduct, and not violate prohibitions established by federal laws;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 12) notify the employer's representative of a personal interest in the performance of official duties that may lead to a conflict of interest, and take measures to prevent such a conflict;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 13) notify the employer’s representative, the prosecutor’s office or other state bodies specified by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation of every approach by any person intended to induce the civil servant to commit corruption offences. The procedure for notifying the employer’s representative of approaches intended to induce a civil servant to commit corruption offences, the information to be included in such notifications, the arrangements for verifying that information and the procedure for registering notifications are determined by the employer’s representative;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 14) notify the employer’s representative in writing of changes that have come to their knowledge in the information contained in the questionnaire provided for by Article 20.3 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, except for information changed by decision of the employer’s representative.
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 1.1. A civil servant is obliged to state monetary values used to value objects of civil rights in accordance with the requirements established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 2. A civil servant may not carry out an unlawful instruction given to them. Upon receiving an instruction from the relevant manager which the civil servant considers unlawful, the civil servant must submit a written explanation of why the instruction is unlawful, specifying the provisions of federal laws and other regulatory legal acts and of laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow which may be violated by carrying it out, and obtain the manager’s written confirmation of the instruction previously given, with a legal justification. If the manager confirms the instruction in writing without a legal justification, the civil servant must refuse to carry it out.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 3. If a civil servant carries out an unlawful instruction, the civil servant and the manager who issued it bear disciplinary, civil, administrative or criminal liability in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 4. If a civil servant fails to carry out a lawful instruction, they bear liability in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 5. To avoid a conflict of interest, a civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ category assigned to the highest group of civil service positions may not represent civil servants’ interests in the elected trade union body of that state body while holding the specified civil service position.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 6. Civil servants are subject to compulsory state fingerprint registration in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.label: Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 1. A civil servant may not remain in the civil service in the event of: 1) being declared legally incapable or having limited legal capacity by a court decision that has entered into legal force;
units.label: Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 2) being sentenced, by a court judgment that has entered into legal force, to a punishment that precludes the performance of official duties in a state service (civil service) position, or having a conviction that has not been expunged or spent in accordance with the procedure established by federal law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 3) refusal to undergo the procedure for obtaining access to information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal law, if the duties of the civil service position sought by the citizen or held by the civil servant involve use of such information;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 4) having a disease that prevents entry into or performance of the civil service, confirmed by a medical organization’s conclusion;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 5) close kinship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers, sisters, and also spouses’ brothers, sisters, parents and children, and children’s spouses) with a civil servant, where holding the civil service position entails one being directly subordinate or accountable to the other;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 6) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 7) holding citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen’s right of permanent residence in a foreign state, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or federal legislation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 8) submission, upon entry into and/or during civil service, of forged documents and/or knowingly false information purporting to confirm compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements whose violation precludes holding a civil service position, or failure to submit documents and/or information showing noncompliance with such restrictions, prohibitions and requirements;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 9) failure to submit, in accordance with the procedure established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow, information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by Federal Law of 25 December 2008 No. 273-ФЗ ‘On Combating Corruption’ (hereinafter referred to as information on income, property and property-related obligations), and information on expenditure provided for by Federal Law of 3 December 2012 No. 230-ФЗ ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income’ (hereinafter referred to as information on expenditure); submission of knowingly incomplete information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure, except in cases established by federal laws; or submission of knowingly inaccurate information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure; 10) loss of the employer’s representative’s trust in the civil servant in cases of failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, other federal laws and this Law.
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 11) failure to submit the information provided for by Article 16.2 of this Law.
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 12) being found, in accordance with a draft commission’s conclusion, not to have performed conscript military service without lawful grounds for not doing so (except citizens who have performed military service under contract) — for 10 years from the expiry of the period established for appealing that conclusion to the draft commission of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation; or, if that conclusion and/or the decision of the draft commission of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the citizen’s appeal against that conclusion was challenged in court, for 10 years from the entry into legal force of the court decision finding that the citizen’s rights were not violated when that conclusion and/or the decision of the draft commission of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the citizen’s appeal against that conclusion was issued.
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
units.text: 2. Other restrictions associated with performance of the civil service, and liability for failure to comply with restrictions, are established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.label: Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 1. In connection with civil service, a civil servant is prohibited from:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 1) this point was repealed with effect from 17 July 2015 by Law of the City of Moscow of 24 June 2015 No. 37,;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 2) holding a civil service position in the event of:
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: a) election or appointment to a state office, except in cases established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «a» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: б) election to an elected office in a local self-government body;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: в) election to a paid elected office in a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 3) participating in the management of a commercial or non-commercial organization, except in cases provided for by point 3 of part 1 of Article 17 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 3.1) engaging in entrepreneurial activity personally or through agents; 4) acquiring income-yielding securities in cases established by federal law;
units.label: Point 3.1 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 5) acting as an attorney or representative for third parties in the state body in which they hold a civil service position, unless otherwise provided by federal laws;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 6) receiving rewards from individuals or legal entities in connection with the performance of official duties (gifts, monetary rewards, loans, services, payment for entertainment, recreation or transport expenses, and other rewards). Gifts received by a civil servant in connection with protocol events, official business trips or other official events are recognized as the property of the City of Moscow and must be transferred by the civil servant, under a transfer record, to the state body in which they hold a civil service position, except in cases established by the Civil Code of the Russian Federation. A civil servant who has surrendered a gift received in connection with a protocol event, official business trip or other official event may purchase it in accordance with the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 7) travelling outside the territory of the Russian Federation in connection with the performance of official duties at the expense of individuals or legal entities, except for official business trips undertaken in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation under arrangements between state bodies of the Russian Federation, state bodies of the City of Moscow or local self-government bodies and state or municipal bodies of foreign states, international organizations or foreign organizations;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 8) using material, technical and other support resources or other state property for purposes unrelated to the performance of official duties, or transferring them to other persons;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 9) disclosing or using for purposes unrelated to civil service information classified as confidential under federal law, or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 10) publicly expressing judgments and assessments, including in the mass media, concerning the activities of state bodies or their heads, including decisions of a superior state body or of the state body in which they hold a civil service position, unless this forms part of their official duties;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 11) accepting, without written permission from the employer's representative, awards or honorary and special titles (except academic titles) from foreign States, international organizations, political parties, other public associations or religious associations, if the civil servant's official duties include interaction with those organizations and associations;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 12) using the advantages of official position for election campaigning or campaigning on referendum issues;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 13) using official powers in the interests of political parties, other public associations, religious associations or other organizations, or publicly expressing an attitude towards those associations and organizations in the capacity of a civil servant, unless this forms part of their official duties; 14) establishing structures of political parties, other public associations (except trade unions, veterans’ bodies and other bodies of public self-activity) or religious associations within state bodies, or assisting in the establishment of such structures;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 15) ceasing to perform official duties for the purpose of resolving service disputes;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 16) being a member of the governing bodies, boards of trustees, supervisory boards or other bodies of foreign non-profit non-governmental organizations or their structural subdivisions operating in the territory of the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 17) engaging, without written permission from the employer’s representative, in paid activity financed exclusively from the funds of foreign states, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens or stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 1.1. A civil servant holding a civil service position included in a list established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, their spouse and their minor children are prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits), keeping cash or valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or owning and/or using foreign financial instruments in the cases provided for by Federal Law of 7 May 2013 No. 79-ФЗ ‘On the Prohibition for Certain Categories of Persons to Open and Hold Accounts (Deposits), Keep Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Own and/or Use Foreign Financial Instruments’.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 2. Where a civil servant’s ownership of securities (participating interests or shares in the authorized or pooled capital of organizations) gives rise or may give rise to a conflict of interest, the civil servant must transfer the securities (participating interests or shares in the authorized or pooled capital of organizations) that they own into trust management in accordance with the civil legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 3. After dismissal from the civil service, a citizen may not disclose or use in the interests of organizations or individuals confidential or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 3.1. For two years after dismissal from the civil service, a citizen who held a civil service position included in a list of positions established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow may not, without the consent of the relevant commission on compliance with requirements for the official conduct of state civil servants and the resolution of conflicts of interest (hereinafter referred to as the conflict-of-interest resolution commission), hold positions in an organization under an employment contract and/or perform work (provide services) for that organization under a civil-law contract (civil-law contracts), in cases provided for by federal laws, if certain functions of state administration of that organization formed part of the civil servant’s official (service) duties. The consent of the relevant conflict-of-interest resolution commission is given in accordance with the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow. Consent of the relevant conflict-of-interest resolution commission is not required where the citizen is appointed to that organization by decision of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 13
